Title: The Biggest tournament ever : French Open

Messages.Author: sla...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
The Saturday 18 of November, the French Open take place.

85 players (from 4 distinct countries) played the official tournament !
And
they ALL stay during the 3 preliminary rounds (There was even about 50
players left after the final who wait for the prizes :)))) .
And if I count players who join for the side-event and the newbe who
play at
demo-games we organize, the event Gather more than 100 players !!!!!!

The most important was that everyone was pleased with the organisation,
and
had a very good time.
It was Philippe BOULE from White-wolf who give the 1st prize to the
Winner.
(thanks to him for coming)

After 3 rounds, the 5 finalist were :
BRISSET Jean-Marc (Ventrue deck)
RAMOS Miguel (Malkavian)
TRAN-VAN Pierre (Weeny deck)
BERTEIL Olivier (Bleed stealth)
OLIVERI Benoit (Weeny deck)

And finaly, the Ventrue deck get the victory with 4VP.
We will put a more detailled report on our website (see below) in a few
days.

Stéphane
Ventrue Prince of Paris
Regent of France
www.multimania.com/parisvekn/

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
corr...@my-deja.com wrote:
> In that moment I can play Claws of dead, Before the range step or
> after, or before the choose the strikes??

Any of the above.
Strike modifiers can be played any time before strike
resolution begins - including during choose strikes
after both combatants have chosen their strikes.
